page_title: MAR 2-2 REI | Marseille v Reims 25/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Lilian Brassier (Marseille) picks up the rebound just outside the box and releases a weak low shot that heads towards the left post, but it fails to give the goalkeeper anything to worry about.
90+3' The Marseille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90+1' Luka Elsner has decided to make a change. Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) replaces Junya Ito.
90+1' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Cedric Kipre (Reims) replaces Keito Nakamura.
88' Marseille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

87' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Yehvann Diouf makes a great save to stop his effort. The ball is out of play. Marseille will have a chance to score from a corner.
86' Valentin Carboni (Marseille) commits a foul and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem immediately signals a free kick.
83' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
82' Geronimo Rulli is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims). Easy save!
81' Junya Ito (Reims) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
80' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem shows a yellow card to Quentin Merlin (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
78' Substitution. Valentin Carboni (Marseille) on for Amine Harit.
78' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
75' Although Roberto De Zerbi (Marseille) is just on the bench, Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
71' 2 - 2 Mason Greenwood (Marseille) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.

71' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
71' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the left post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
70' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
67' It will be a substitution. Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) is ready to enter the pitch as Elye Wahi walks off.
67' The ball rebounds out to Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
66' Luka Elsner has decided to substitute Oumar Diakite and he is replaced by Amine Salama (Reims).
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Yaya-Kader Fofana will be replaced by Martin Adeline (Reims).
65' Oumar Diakite (Reims) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
65' Elye Wahi (Marseille) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
62' Junya Ito (Reims) tries to find Oumar Diakite with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
59' Oumar Diakite (Reims) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem who sees an offensive foul.
58' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem to decide. The relieved Reims players can finally celebrate.
57' Celebrations by Reims are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.

55' 1 - 2 Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) scores a great goal! He skips past the defending players, gets inside the penalty area, pretends to shoot to the right and as the keeper falls for it, he easily sends the ball in the other direction.
53' Sergio Akieme (Reims) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

51' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Sergio Akieme (Reims) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Geronimo Rulli. 1:1.
50' Reims can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
50' Keito Nakamura (Reims) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Geronimo Rulli stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner. Reims get a corner.

49' Keito Nakamura (Reims) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
46' Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.

45+3' Elye Wahi (Marseille) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.

45+2' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
45+1' Junya Ito (Reims) whips in a cross from the corner, but Geronimo Rulli is well positioned and punches the ball away.
45+1' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Elye Wahi (Marseille) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Yehvann Diouf.
44' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
42' Junya Ito (Reims) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
38' A decent save by Yehvann Diouf. Elye Wahi (Marseille) finds some space near the penalty spot to meet a cross and head it down to the middle of the goal, but the effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
37' Sergio Akieme (Reims) latched on to a cross on the edge of the box, but his strike isn't accurate at all and the ball goes way wide of the left post.
33' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
32' Elye Wahi (Marseille) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.

31' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Yehvann Diouf pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
28' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post.
25' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Amine Harit (Marseille) receives a precise pass inside the box from Quentin Merlin and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
22' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yehvann Diouf intercepts the ball.
21' Reims take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
18' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
18' PENALTY APPEAL after Mason Greenwood (Marseille) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
15' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.

14' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Yehvann Diouf!
13' Junya Ito (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but Geronimo Rulli comes off his line to gather the ball.
10' The ball is cleared after Quentin Merlin (Marseille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
8' Oumar Diakite (Reims) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
5' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Elye Wahi (Marseille) offside.
2' Elye Wahi (Marseille) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
1' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Marseille will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem.
